correctness.rationale: The printed CW cell set consists of a nonempty subset I of n vertices and one of q edge colors for every pair of I. Oriented g-actions have sign of the restriction to I. For each invariant I, colorings fixed by (g,h) are products over unordered-edge orbits of |Fix(h^length)|. Vertex-cycle pair orbits have gcd(a,b) orbits of length lcm(a,b); intracycle non-diameters contribute floor((a-1)/2) orbits of length a, and even-cycle diameters one orbit of length a/2. Reduced augmented Hopf trace, with only degree n-1 rational homology from Ayzenberg--Khoroshavkina Theorem 5.1, yields the exact (-1)^n cycle-index character. The identity g=h=1 gives the finite alternating sum for beta. For n=3 every S3-invariant oriented 1-cell is killed by an endpoint swap and 0-cells have only the augmentation invariant, whereas invariant 2-cells are alternating tensors on three distinct color slots; hence top invariants are wedge^3(Q^q). Independent direct enumeration of vertex-invariant subsets and their literal unordered-pair cycles agrees with cycle-index predictions for four nonidentity (g,h) examples: traces -2,0,1,-8. Finite checks corroborate, but are not the wedge theorem or an infinite proof. Rational quotient representation is proved; no assertion on integral torsion or full quotient homotopy type.
